errors.description: packet_q is a multi-bit value produced in s_axis_clk and sampled directly in m_axis_clk without a bundled-data handshake or hold guarantee.
tlast_pulse_q is a one-cycle s_axis_clk pulse consumed directly in m_axis_clk, so the event can be missed or sampled metastably.
tlast_toggle_q reconverges with a one-sample m_axis_clk history, allowing metastability or double-counting in m_axis_event_o.
route_sync_q receives independently synchronized bits from encoded control vector route_q before decoding in m_axis_clk, so transient illegal modes can be observed.
s_axis_rst_n is used as data inside m_axis_clk logic, so reset deassertion can asynchronously change destination state.
cfg_snapshot_q combines s_axis_clk payload state with m_axis_clk status state in cfg_clk without a cross-domain snapshot protocol.
